name: malformed-locator-stays-outside-the-typed-set
description: A URI with an empty session segment names no render locator, so it is not a read of one and the four classifications do not apply to it. It must not come back as NOT_FOUND: that would make a malformed request indistinguishable from a real miss and would tell a host to stop retrying a request it should fix instead. Which number a malformed URI DOES receive belongs to the transport binding and is deliberately not pinned here.
